capacity.partition: floor(global cap / worker count), no lending, unused remainder retained

checks.transport: Explicit method whitelist; opaque worker-local tokens and RGB traces; no RAM, rewards, lives, native snapshots, import/export or restore RPC.
checks.failure_latch: Save/pair/drop exceptions stop every subsequent parent action; report/drop remain available; cleanup never reopens stopped play.

tests.real_spawn: Two real Windows child processes use wholly synthetic engine factories; no ALE constructor.

independent_internal_drop_witness.injection: MemoryError from serialized-byte counter subtraction inside engine drop

independent_second_branch_failure_rpc.injection: MemoryError on ninth recorder append, first frame of second branch

resolved_findings.problem: Failed archive_drop originally left parent action dispatch open even if its worker was poisoned.
resolved_findings.resolution: archive_drop now latches _stopped on any exception while remaining callable for cleanup after a stop; independently verified with an internal arithmetic failure and no dispatch to the other worker.

limitations: This is a source and synthetic transport review, not a native archive validation or permission to collect or train.
The 2GB cap covers retained serialized payload, not process RSS, transient serialization buffers, unpickling buffers or in-flight RGB trace copies.

Native save/restore, terminal/cold behavior and sticky/RGB continuation still require a separately reviewed prospective native archive protocol; the existing current-anchor trace wiring does not establish the additional archive behavior.

Workers may have advanced during an already dispatched ordinary batch before a peer error is received. Monotone worker ledgers must all be drained and preserved by the future runner; this pool does not itself provide durable aggregate receipts.
If process or transport loss prevents a report, paid cost may be unknown; future runner accounting must identify unavailable reports and mark aggregate accounting incomplete.
The parent deliberately treats even a recoverable capacity or invalid-token error as a permanent action stop. A future collector must check allocation and choose deletions before calling save.

Private underscore methods and trusted Python process memory are not an adversarial sandbox; the audited public RPC whitelist is the intended experimenter boundary. No durable E4 return or archive-cell policy is implemented here.
